claim_boundary: fresh fixed-weight matched-target state collection for descriptive transport-residual analysis; no intervention, routing, adaptation, learning, or channel-causality claim
matched_target_rule: For every base binary history s, heldout order receives symbols [s2,s0,s1,s4,s5,s3]. Every moved symbol retains its base-order reliability, so the complete evidence-pair multiset and log-odds target are identical while cue position changes.
controls: All 64 histories per order/seed/checkpoint; base-order stratified train32/eval32 split; analytic latest-cue and conditional train-label shuffle. No heldout-order state, label, normalization, decoder, tracker, centering, relationship map, or threshold fits an object.
decision_rule: Collect this batch before computing descriptors. The following analysis must use only base-order train32-fitted projection, centering, proper-orthogonal tracker, and relationship maps. It will report per-projection full residual energy, six channel residual-energy fractions, and carrier-to-slow plus gate-to-message residual cross-covariance/cross-prediction. A descriptor is a confirmation candidate only if its predeclared direction separates strict heldout pass/fail cells in at least three of four seeds at a checkpoint; otherwise no descriptor is nominated. This is descriptive association, not route causality.
